description: This file implements a cascade delete operation for a chapter in a learning or content management system. It deletes associated files, questions, attempts, images, RAG conversations, embeddings, and the chapter entry itself, updating storage and vector store accordingly.

classes.name: JSONStorage
classes.description: Handles JSON-based storage operations for different data collections.

classes.name: LocalVectorStore
classes.description: Manages vector embeddings storage and retrieval, likely for similarity search.

methods.name: cascade_delete_chapter
methods.description: Deletes a chapter and all related data, including files, questions, attempts, images, RAG conversations, embeddings, and the chapter record itself.
